name: Kaeng Krachan Forest Complex
description: Kaeng Krachan is a vast forest of misty ridges and dense jungle in western Thailand, running along the Myanmar border in the Tenasserim mountains. It sits where Himalayan, Indochinese and Sumatran wildlife meet, and shelters tigers, elephants, banteng and critically endangered Siamese crocodiles. Remarkably, eight wild cat species live here, from clouded leopards to fishing cats.
